english.title: Motor vehicle fail to comply with solid white line road markings - automatic equipment

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2002

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), and failed to comply with the indication given by solid white line road markings outlined in diagram 1013.1 or diagram 1013.5 of Schedule 9 to the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016, lawfully placed on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 36(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, Schedule 9 to the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See offence document H12692 for the same offence detected by manned equipment
(ii) Offence document H12686 and H12687 cater for general endorsable section 36 traffic signs (excluding stop signs, traffic lights and solid white lines)
(iii) Offence documents H12688 and H12689 cater for the contravention of stop signs.
(iv) Offence documents H12690 and H12691 cater for the contravention of traffic lights.
(v) Non-endorsable section 36 traffic signs are catered for by offence documents H12682 (ACD) and H12683 (non-ACD)
